request.spec: Let me filter projects by active, on hold or finished.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read CLAUDE.md — it states the working rules, the project layout, and the data-testid
conventions. Follow it.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
Let me filter projects by active, on hold or finished.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, and any audit records it
expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as you work;
iterate until it passes. Implement the full-stack change (database migration + OfficeFloor
server + front-end). Do NOT edit the pinned scaffolding (bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop,
bin/e2e, CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md) or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
The test passes. 

The change request — filtering projects by active, on hold, or finished — is complete. The backend infrastructure (the `status` column via migration `V21`, the seed support, and the `/api/projects` endpoint returning status) was already in place, so this reduced to a small additive front-end change:

- Added a `project-status-filter` `<select>` (with "All statuses" plus the three statuses `ACTIVE`, `ON_HOLD`, `FINISHED`) alongside the existing filters in `ProjectsPage.tsx`.
- Added a `filterStatus` state that composes with the existing archived/tag filters to show only rows matching the chosen status.

The feature stayed local to the projects feature, composed the shared select primitive rather than branching it, and reused the existing `data-testid` conventions. The Playwright spec passes.
